# `spirula sfm` flags

Every flag in the SfM descriptor table (`src/sfm/SfmConfig.h`), with the subcommands that accept it. The flags each subcommand parses by hand, and `sfm ba`, are in [sfm.md](sfm.md).

## Flags

Defaults are a fresh config, which is what `--help` prints; `auto` then applies `--quality` and `--data-type` (see [sfm.md](sfm.md#presets)). A switch is written `--name` / `--no-name`. Basic flags are what the GUI shows unfolded.

### Pipeline

| Flag | Commands | Default | Tier | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--quality` | auto | `high` | basic | Working resolution, feature budget and pair-selection breadth. One of: `low`, `medium`, `high`, `extreme`. |
| `--data-type` | auto | `individual` | basic | What the capture is: individual photos, video frames, or an unordered internet collection. One of: `individual`, `video`, `internet`. |
| `--pairs` | auto, match | `auto` | basic | Which image pairs are matched; auto is GPU pair selection at 100 images or more, sequential (plus loop closure) for video below that, and exhaustive otherwise. One of: `auto`, `exhaustive`, `sequential`, `prefilter`. |
| `--overlap` | auto, match, map | `10` | advanced | Neighbours in file order each image is paired with under --pairs sequential and --prefilter-sequential. Range 1 to 1000000. |
| `--loop-closure` / `--no-loop-closure` | auto, match | `on` | advanced | Under --pairs sequential, also match the content-similar pairs GPU pair selection finds, so a capture that revisits a place links back to it. |
| `--quadratic-overlap` / `--no-quadratic-overlap` | auto, match | `off` | advanced | A sequential window also pairs each image with the ones 2, 4, 8 ... apart in file order, up to 2^(overlap-1), as COLMAP does. |
| `--prefilter-sequential` / `--no-prefilter-sequential` | auto, match | `off` | advanced | When GPU pair selection runs, also match each image with its neighbours in file order within its folder (the sequential window, --overlap and --quadratic-overlap), so a real link the content score ranked too low is not lost. |
| `--rig-pairs` / `--no-rig-pairs` | auto, match | `on` | advanced | On a dual-fisheye rig, match each verified pair's rig-mates too: when cam0 of two frames matched, cam1 of the same two frames; when cam0 matched cam1, the camera had turned round, so cam1 against cam0. |
| `--rig-pair-angle` | auto, match | `30` | advanced | How far apart, in degrees, two rig-mates' viewing directions may be for --rig-pairs to match them. Range 0 to 180. |
| `--rig-pair-min-inliers` | auto, match | `30` | advanced | Inliers a verified pair needs before --rig-pairs matches its rig-mates. Range 0 to 100000. |
| `--max-error` | auto, match, map | `3` | advanced | Inlier radius for verification and mapping, in pixels of the image SIFT ran on rather than of the source file (D47) Range 0.1 to 100. |
| `--max-image-size` | auto, extract | `0` | advanced | Longest edge the extractor runs on; larger images are downscaled first, and keypoints are still reported in the source image's pixels. 0 picks the frontend's own default (3200 for sift, 1600 for aliked) Range 0 to 20000. |
| `--masks` | auto, extract | `none` | basic | Directory of masks; keypoints on zero (black) pixels are dropped. auto defaults it to `masks` beside the image directory. |
| `--mask-dir` | auto, extract | `none` | alias | Another spelling of `--masks`. |
| `--flip-mask` / `--no-flip-mask` | auto, extract | `off` | advanced | Swap keep and ignore in every mask, for the exporters that paint the region to REMOVE rather than the region to keep. |
| `--feature-masks` | auto, extract | `none` | advanced | A second directory of masks, intersected with --masks: keypoints are kept only where both are nonzero. For what the reconstruction should not use but training should, such as the sky. Never flipped. |

### Progressive

| Flag | Commands | Default | Tier | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--progressive` / `--no-progressive` | auto, match | `off` | advanced | Progressive alignment: map at a loose pixel error first, then again at tighter ones, each attempt continuing from the last. |
| `--progressive-error-start` | auto, match | `20` | advanced | Pixel error of the first progressive attempt; matches are verified at it. Range 0.1 to 1000. |
| `--progressive-error-end` | auto | `0` | advanced | Pixel error of the last progressive attempt, and so of the written model; 0 is --max-error. Range 0 to 1000. |
| `--progressive-error-steps` | auto | `5` | advanced | Progressive attempts from the start error to the end error, both included, spaced evenly in ratio. Range 2 to 50. |
| `--progressive-features` / `--no-progressive-features` | auto | `on` | advanced | After the error steps, detect features again on images still outside the largest model, with more features and resolution each pass. |
| `--progressive-max-features-end` | auto | `0` | advanced | Feature limit of the last feature pass; the first uses the run's own. 0 is four times the run's. Range 0 to 1000000. |
| `--progressive-image-size-end` | auto | `0` | advanced | Image size limit of the last feature pass, in pixels on the long edge; the first uses the run's own. 0 is the images' full size. Range 0 to 20000. |
| `--progressive-feature-steps` | auto | `3` | advanced | Feature passes from the run's settings to the ends. Range 1 to 20. |
| `--progressive-patience` | auto | `2` | advanced | Tries in a row that align no new image before a stage gives up: the pixel error steps skip to the final error, and the feature passes stop. Range 1 to 20. |
| `--progressive-min-matches` | auto | `50` | advanced | Verified matches an unaligned image needs to be worked on; below it, the image is taken for an outlier and left alone. Range 0 to 1000000. |
| `--progressive-time` | auto | `0` | advanced | Minutes into progressive alignment after which no further feature pass starts; 0 is no limit. Range 0 to 100000. |

### Colour

| Flag | Commands | Default | Tier | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--image-gamut` | auto, extract | `Rec.709` | advanced | Colour primaries the input images were captured in. Pixels are converted to sRGB before feature extraction, which is what the detectors and the AI models expect. One of: `Rec.709`, `ACES2065-1`, `ACEScg`, `Rec.2020`, `AdobeRGB`, `DCI-P3`. |
| `--image-linear` / `--no-image-linear` | auto, extract | `off` | advanced | Treat the input images as linear light rather than display-encoded. |
| `--image-exposure` | auto, extract | `none` | advanced | Brighten what the detectors see, in linear light, without touching the files: auto lifts each image whose median is darker than a typical photograph's, or give a number of stops (2, -1). Point colours and the training images keep the files' own values. |
| `--point-color` | auto, extract | `srgb` | advanced | Colour space the sparse point cloud is written in. image writes the points in the same space as the photographs, which the trainer assumes by default; srgb needs the trainer's point-color-gamut set to Rec.709. One of: `srgb`, `image`. |

### Camera

| Flag | Commands | Default | Tier | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--camera-mode` | auto, match, map | `folder` | basic | How images are grouped into cameras; every mode splits on image resolution first. One of: `single`, `folder`, `image`. |
| `--camera-model` | auto, match, map | `opencv` | basic | Distortion model fitted to each camera group; also takes PREFIX=MODEL to set one group. One of: `simple-pinhole`, `pinhole`, `radial`, `opencv`, `full-opencv`, `opencv-fisheye`, `thin-prism-fisheye`, `equirectangular`. |
| `--focal` | auto, match, map | `0` | basic | Starting focal length in pixels, 0 to guess from EXIF or image size; also takes PREFIX=F. Range 0 to 10000000. |
| `--distortion` | auto, match, map | `none` | advanced | Distortion coefficients to start from, "k1,k2,..." in the model's own order; also takes PREFIX=k1,k2,... |
| `--exif-focal` / `--no-exif-focal` | auto, match, map | `on` | advanced | Use the focal length EXIF recorded when no --focal covers the group. |
| `--exif-groups` / `--no-exif-groups` | auto, match, map | `on` | advanced | Split camera groups by what EXIF says the body and the focal setting were (D48) |
| `--exif-focal-tol` | auto, match, map | `0.1` | advanced | Relative tolerance clustering EXIF focals into one group; must exceed EXIF's 1 mm quantization and stay under a real zoom step. Range 0.001 to 1. |
| `--exif-orientation` | auto, extract, map, merge | `orient` | advanced | What each photo's EXIF orientation is worth: `none` ignores it, `orient` leaves the pixels alone and takes the scene's up direction from it, `apply` turns the pixels and fits cameras to the turned frame. One of: `none`, `orient`, `apply`. |

### Features

| Flag | Commands | Default | Tier | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--features` | auto, extract | `sift` | basic | Which detector and descriptor; the aliked and loma ones are learned and fetch a checkpoint on first use. One of: `sift`, `aliked-n16rot`, `aliked-n32`, `loma-b128`, `loma-b`. |
| `--max-features` | auto, extract | `8192` | advanced | Keypoints kept per image with --features sift, the largest scales first. Range 128 to 1000000. |
| `--aliked-max-features` | auto, extract | `2048` | advanced | Keypoints kept per image with a learned frontend, the highest scores first. Range 128 to 1000000. |
| `--aliked-min-score` | auto, extract | `0.2` | advanced | Detection score a learned keypoint must reach. Range 0 to 1. |
| `--aliked-model` | auto, extract | `aliked-n16rot` | advanced | Path to an ALIKED .onnx checkpoint, overriding the one --features names. |
| `--loma-max-features` | auto, extract | `2048` | advanced | Keypoints kept per image with a learned frontend, the highest scores first. Range 128 to 1000000. |
| `--loma-min-score` | auto, extract | `0` | advanced | Detection score a learned keypoint must reach. Range 0 to 1. |
| `--loma-detector-model` | auto, extract | `none` | advanced | Path to a LoMa .onnx checkpoint, overriding the one --features or --matcher names. |
| `--loma-descriptor-model` | auto, extract | `none` | advanced | Path to a LoMa .onnx checkpoint, overriding the one --features or --matcher names. |
| `--octaves` | auto, extract | `4` | advanced | Scale-space octaves. Range 1 to 8. |
| `--peak-threshold` | auto, extract | `0.00666667` | advanced | DoG response a keypoint must reach. Range 0 to 1. |
| `--edge-threshold` | auto, extract | `10` | advanced | Principal-curvature ratio above which a keypoint is an edge, not a corner. Range 1 to 1000. |
| `--max-orientations` | auto, extract | `2` | advanced | Descriptors emitted per keypoint when its gradient is ambiguous. Range 1 to 8. |
| `--profile` / `--no-profile` | extract | `off` | advanced | Print per-stage GPU timings for the extractor. |
| `--spv-path` | extract | `none` | advanced | Load the SIFT kernels from this SPIR-V file instead of the embedded blob. |

### Matching

| Flag | Commands | Default | Tier | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--matcher` | auto, match | `bruteforce` | basic | How descriptors are matched. lightglue and loma-* are learned matchers, each for the --features of the same name; both are an order of magnitude slower per pair, so they only make sense behind pair selection. One of: `bruteforce`, `lightglue`, `loma-b128`, `loma-b`, `loma-r`, `loma-l`, `loma-g`. |
| `--lightglue-min-score` | auto, match | `0.1` | advanced | Assignment confidence a LightGlue match must reach. Range 0 to 1. |
| `--lightglue-model` | auto, match | `aliked-lightglue` | advanced | Path to a LightGlue .onnx checkpoint, overriding the fetched one. |
| `--loma-min-match-score` | auto, match | `0.1` | advanced | Assignment confidence a LoMa match must reach. Range 0 to 1. |
| `--loma-matcher-model` | auto, match | `none` | advanced | Path to a LoMa .onnx checkpoint, overriding the one --features or --matcher names. |
| `--ratio` | auto, match | `0.8` | advanced | Lowe ratio: a match is kept when the best distance is below this times the second best. Range 0 to 1. |
| `--min-similarity` | auto, match | `0` | advanced | Cosine similarity a match must reach, for float descriptors; 0 disables it. Learned descriptors are filtered on this rather than on the ratio. Range 0 to 1. |
| `--cross-check` / `--no-cross-check` | auto, match | `on` | advanced | Keep only mutual nearest neighbours. |
| `--max-matches` | auto, match | `32768` | advanced | Cap on matches per pair, 0 for no cap. Range 0 to 1000000000. |
| `--verify` / `--no-verify` | match | `on` | advanced | Geometrically verify each pair (F/H RANSAC); off keeps the raw putative matches. |
| `--min-inliers` | auto, match | `15` | advanced | Inliers a verified pair must keep to be recorded. Range 4 to 1000000. |
| `--prefilter-features` | auto, match | `512` | advanced | Query descriptors per image in the pair-selection pass. Range 16 to 100000. |
| `--prefilter-train` | auto, match | `0` | advanced | Cap on the train side of that pass, 0 to score against every descriptor. Range 0 to 1000000. |
| `--prefilter-neighbors` | auto, match | `32` | advanced | Best-scoring partners each image keeps for full matching. Range 1 to 100000. |
| `--prefilter-min-score` | auto, match | `4` | advanced | Mini-matches below which a pair never qualifies. Range 0 to 1000000. |
| `--prefilter-ratio` | auto, match | `0.8` | advanced | Lowe ratio of the scoring pass; looser than the matcher's, as it only ranks. Range 0 to 1. |
| `--order-weight` | auto, match | `0` | advanced | How much pair selection favours images close in file order within a folder; an adjacent image's score counts 1 + this times. 0 is off. Range 0 to 100. |
| `--order-decay` | auto, match | `5` | advanced | File-order distance, in images, over which the --order-weight bonus falls to about a third. Range 0.1 to 100000. |

### Mapper

| Flag | Commands | Default | Tier | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--compact-unused-features` / `--no-compact-unused-features` | auto, map | `on` | advanced | Keep in memory only feature rows referenced by stored matches; files on disk stay unchanged. |
| `--focal-trials` | auto, map | `5` | advanced | Trial reconstructions used to pick a focal the motion cannot determine (D48), 0 to skip. Range 0 to 1000. |
| `--refine-principal-point` / `--no-refine-principal-point` | auto, map | `off` | advanced | Let BA move cx,cy throughout; off as in COLMAP, where it is nearly a camera rotation (D50) |
| `--final-principal-point` / `--no-final-principal-point` | auto, map | `on` | advanced | One principal-point-free global BA on the finished model, for a single camera group (D51) |
| `--pp-min-images` | auto, map | `20` | advanced | Images a group needs before that final pass runs on it. Range 2 to 1000000. |
| `--refine-extra-params` / `--no-refine-extra-params` | auto, map | `on` | advanced | Let BA move the distortion coefficients throughout; off holds them and leaves them to the final pass (D72) |
| `--final-extra-params` / `--no-final-extra-params` | auto, map | `on` | advanced | Release the distortion coefficients for the global BA on the finished model; off holds the principal point with them. |
| `--final-per-image-intrinsics` / `--no-final-per-image-intrinsics` | auto, map | `off` | advanced | One more global BA at the very end with every image on its own intrinsics, and nothing clamped back to the group (D73) |
| `--orient` / `--no-orient` | auto, map, merge | `on` | advanced | Write the model upright, centred and unit-scaled from the camera poses, instead of in the seed pair's arbitrary gauge. |
| `--level` | auto, map, merge | `ground` | advanced | What levels a model nothing measured, and where a measured one's ground goes: `ground` finds the plane the points stand on, puts it at z = 0, turns the walls onto the axes and centres the footprint (a sensor-levelled model is only moved up or down); `cameras` levels on the cameras' mean up axis. One of: `ground`, `cameras`. |
| `--metric-positions` | auto, map, merge | `none` | advanced | Write the model in the metric frame of these camera positions (one `image_name X Y Z` per line, metres); a failed fit is reported and the model is written un-scaled. |
| `--metric-gps` | auto, map, merge | `auto` | advanced | Fit a local east-north-up metre frame to the images' EXIF GPS: `horizontal` reads latitude and longitude and leaves the tilt to the cameras' own up axis, `full` reads altitude too; accuracy is a few metres, so the capture must be tens of metres across. `auto`, the default, picks `full` for a DJI telemetry track or EXIF fixes with an altitude, `horizontal` for other telemetry, a phone's EXIF or fixes without an altitude, and `none` without GPS or beside --metric-positions. One of: `auto`, `none`, `horizontal`, `full`. |
| `--exif-attitude` | auto, map, merge | `auto` | advanced | Fix the model's up, and north, from the camera attitude each image records (a DJI drone's gimbal angles): `auto` takes both, `up` the tilt alone, `none` ignores it. One of: `auto`, `up`, `none`. |
| `--metric-max-error` | auto, map, merge | `0` | advanced | Cameras farther than this many metres from the fitted position are outliers; 0 takes the radius from how far the positions scatter about the fit. Range 0 to 1000000. |
| `--metric-max-error-frac` | auto, map, merge | `0.03` | advanced | ... or, with --metric-max-error above 0, this fraction of the reference positions' RMS radius, whichever is larger, so a long flight is not judged by a threshold made for a walk. Range 0 to 1. |
| `--telemetry` | auto, match, map, merge | `none` | advanced | A video whose IMU and GPS cover the images (Insta360 .insv, GoPro .360/.mp4, DJI .OSV, CAMM): up comes from the accelerometer, scale from the accelerometer and the GPS log, heading and place from the GPS. Frame names must carry the source frame index, as the extractor writes them. A manifest lists one per camera group. |
| `--sensor-gauge` | auto, map, merge | `auto` | advanced | What the telemetry fixes: `auto` takes up, scale and place from whatever passes its checks, `up` the orientation alone, `none` ignores the sensors. One of: `auto`, `up`, `none`. |
| `--sensor-verify` / `--no-sensor-verify` | auto, match | `on` | advanced | Verify a pair whose rotation the video's gyro knows with that rotation held, keeping only the matches it explains. |
| `--sensor-map` / `--no-sensor-map` | auto, map | `on` | advanced | Hold registrations and bundle adjustments to the sensors: the gyro's rotations, gravity, the accelerometer's scale and the GPS. |
| `--level-erp` / `--no-level-erp` | auto, map | `on` | advanced | Needs EXIF GPS. Hold every equirect image level, camera -Y up: an up factor per image and a tilt check on each registration, both dropped for a run whose images are not level to about 1 deg. |
| `--sensor-pairs` / `--no-sensor-pairs` | auto, match | `off` | advanced | Match images the GPS puts within --sensor-pair-radius metres of each other. |
| `--sensor-pair-radius` | auto, match | `20` | advanced | Metres between two GPS positions for --sensor-pairs to match their images. Range 0 to 100000. |
| `--sensor-max-dt` | auto, match, map | `3` | advanced | Longest gap in seconds a gyro rotation prior may span between two images. Range 0.01 to 1000. |
| `--min-tri-angle` | auto, map | `1.5` | advanced | Triangulation angle a 3D point must subtend to be kept. Range 0 to 90. |
| `--init-min-tri-angle` | auto, map | `16` | advanced | Median triangulation angle the seed pair must reach; relaxed stepwise if nothing passes. Range 0 to 90. |
| `--min-pnp-inliers` | auto, map | `15` | advanced | 2D-3D inliers an image needs to register. Range 4 to 1000000. |
| `--min-pnp-ratio` | auto, map | `0.25` | advanced | Inlier fraction an image needs to register, which rejects accidental agreement. Range 0 to 1. |
| `--min-image-points` | auto, map | `5` | advanced | Observations below which a registered image is dropped again. Range 1 to 1000000. |
| `--ba-loss` | auto, map | `huber` | advanced | Robust loss used by mapping-time bundle adjustment. One of: `trivial`, `huber`, `cauchy`. |
| `--ba-loss-param` | auto, map | `2` | advanced | Huber delta / Cauchy c, in extraction pixels. Range 0 to 1000. |
| `--seed-homography` / `--no-seed-homography` | auto, map | `on` | advanced | Re-test a seed candidate for a planar or panoramic configuration on its own inliers, rather than trusting verification's verdict. |
| `--ba-real` | auto, map | `double` | advanced | Scalar bundle adjustment computes in; df emulates double with a pair of floats, which wins where fp64 throughput is a fraction of fp32. One of: `float`, `double`, `df`, `cpu`. |
| `--ba-real-coarse` | auto, map | `double` | advanced | Scalar for solves another solve will redo -- growth refinements and merge-tree levels; set equal to --ba-real to compute everything the same way. One of: `float`, `double`, `df`, `cpu`. |
| `--ba-solver` | auto, map | `auto` | advanced | Linear solver for the reduced camera system; auto switches to CG above the size where the dense factorization stops paying. One of: `auto`, `dense`, `cg`. |
| `--retri-scale` | auto, map | `0.75` | advanced | Retriangulation tolerance as a fraction of --max-error, 0 to skip the pass. Range 0 to 10. |
| `--merge-tracks` / `--no-merge-tracks` | auto, map | `on` | advanced | Fuse two 3D points a correspondence says are the same feature. |
| `--seam-weld` | auto, map | `0.25` | advanced | Weld open seams: a verified pair of 100+ matches that the finished model explains below this fraction, and whose images share almost no neighbours, is fused and refined; 0 to skip. Range 0 to 1. |
| `--gps-scale-band` | auto, map | `1` | advanced | Check the growing chain's scale against the GPS over 60-150 m of track and request a bundle adjustment when a block has drifted; 0 to skip. Range 0 to 1. |
| `--rank-by-visibility` / `--no-rank-by-visibility` | auto, map | `on` | advanced | Rank the next image by how its visible structure spreads over the frame, not by count. |
| `--seed-blocking` / `--no-seed-blocking` | auto, map | `on` | advanced | A seed retry starts somewhere no earlier attempt reached, instead of rebuilding it. |
| `--mapper` | auto, map | `flat` | basic | One incremental reconstruction of the whole capture, or small atoms of the view graph reconstructed separately and merged upwards. One of: `flat`, `bottom-up`. |
| `--bup-atom-size` | auto, map | `48` | advanced | Images a view-graph atom is split until it is under. Range 8 to 100000. |
| `--bup-overlap` | auto, map | `12` | advanced | Images each atom borrows from its sibling, which is what a merge aligns on. Range 0 to 100000. |
| `--bup-rounds` | auto, map | `16` | advanced | Levels of the merge tree. Range 1 to 100. |
| `--bup-atom-threads` | auto, map | `0` | advanced | Atoms reconstructed at once, each on its own Vulkan context; 0 for the default. Range 0 to 1024. |
| `--bup-atom-ba-growth` | auto, map | `2` | advanced | Model growth that triggers a bundle adjustment inside an atom. Range 1 to 1000000. |
| `--bup-joint-every` | auto, map | `1` | advanced | Merge-tree levels between joint solves over every model. Range 1 to 100. |
| `--bup-atom-tight-final` / `--no-bup-atom-tight-final` | auto, map | `off` | advanced | Converge each atom fully before the merge tree re-solves it anyway. |
| `--bup-coarse-ba` / `--no-bup-coarse-ba` | auto, map | `on` | advanced | Run the merge tree's intermediate joint solves to the loose growth-phase tolerance. |
| `--bup-atom-init-trials` | auto, map | `8` | advanced | Seed attempts for an atom's primary model. Range 1 to 1000. |
| `--bup-atom-min-fraction` | auto, map | `0` | advanced | Fraction of an atom its primary model must cover to be kept. Range 0 to 1. |
| `--bup-joint-intrinsics` / `--no-bup-joint-intrinsics` | auto, map | `on` | advanced | Bundle-adjust every model in one problem with the intrinsics shared per camera. |
| `--bup-grow-every` | auto, map | `1` | advanced | Levels between growth passes over the models that did not merge; 0 disables. Range 0 to 100. |
| `--bup-grow-budget` | auto, map | `0.25` | advanced | Images one growth pass may add to a model, as a fraction of what it holds. Range 0 to 1000. |
| `--ba-growth` | auto, map | `1.1` | advanced | Model growth that triggers the next global bundle adjustment. Range 1 to 100. |
| `--ba-growth-rtol` | auto, map | `0.0001` | advanced | Relative cost improvement a growth-phase BA stops below, 0 for the solver's. Range 0 to 1. |
| `--ba-growth-patience` | auto, map | `5` | advanced | Accepted steps below that tolerance before it stops. Range 1 to 1000. |
| `--max-models` | auto, map | `50` | advanced | Reconstructions a fragmented capture may produce; 1 for a single model. Range 1 to 100000. |
| `--model-overlap` | auto, map | `20` | advanced | Images a further model may take from one already kept -- what a merge later aligns on. Range 0 to 1000000. |
| `--model-overlap-ratio` | auto, map | `1` | advanced | Further images it earns per image it finds that nothing holds, on top of --model-overlap; 0 for COLMAP's flat cap (D66) Range 0 to 1000. |
| `--min-model-size` | auto, map | `10` | advanced | Images a model must reach to be kept at all. Range 2 to 1000000. |
| `--pnp-ratio-visible` / `--no-pnp-ratio-visible` | auto, map | `on` | advanced | Measure the PnP inlier ratio over the correspondences the pose could see, not every one offered (D69) |
| `--strong-pnp-inliers` | auto, map | `0` | advanced | Agreeing correspondences past which a registration is admitted whatever its inlier ratio, since the ratio reads a pool the scene decides (D69); 0 off. Range 0 to 1000000. |
| `--strong-pnp-max-rival` | auto, map | `0.5` | advanced | ... but only if no second pose explains this share of the winner's count among the correspondences it rejected -- two plausible places is not evidence. Range 0 to 1. |
| `--audit-evidence` | auto, map | `40` | advanced | Correspondences an image needs before the audit will judge its pose. Range 0 to 1000000. |

### Rigs

| Flag | Commands | Default | Tier | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--rigs` / `--no-rigs` | auto, map | `on` | advanced | Use the rigs --rig and the manifest define: one pose per frame, member extrinsics shared across frames, lenses placed by their rig-mates. |
| `--refine-rigs` / `--no-refine-rigs` | auto, map | `on` | advanced | Let bundle adjustment refine the member extrinsics; off holds them at the estimated or given values. |
| `--rig-blind` / `--no-rig-blind` | auto, map | `on` | advanced | Register a lens with too few correspondences to be judged at the pose its rig implies, so a lens on the sky still gets its pose. |
| `--rig-min-frames` | auto, map | `3` | advanced | Frames in which a member and its rig's reference lens both registered before the member's extrinsic is trusted and refined. Range 2 to 1000000. |
| `--rig-max-spread` | auto, map | `1` | advanced | Degrees a frame's relative pose may differ from the rig's average before it counts as an outlier; a rig whose median deviation exceeds this is not synchronized and is not enforced. Range 0 to 180. |
| `--final-free-rig` / `--no-final-free-rig` | auto, map | `off` | advanced | After everything else, one bundle adjustment with the rig set aside so every image settles on its own pose. |

### Manage

| Flag | Commands | Default | Tier | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--rounds` | auto, map | `16` | alias | Another spelling of `--bup-rounds`. Range 1 to 1000. |
| `--max-bridges` | auto, map | `0` | advanced | Merges a stalled level may attempt on shared structure instead of shared images (D70); off, because the seam test then judges the evidence that made them. Range 0 to 1000. |
| `--merge` / `--no-merge` | auto, map | `on` | advanced | Merge models that share images, on the Sim(3) those shared poses give (D43) |
| `--grow` / `--no-grow` | auto, map | `on` | advanced | Register still-unregistered images into the models that exist. |
| `--reseed` / `--no-reseed` | auto, map | `on` | advanced | Look for further models among the images nothing covers. |
| `--audit` / `--no-audit` | auto, map | `off` | advanced | Check each pose against the correspondence graph and re-register what a model cannot support (D44) |
| `--split` / `--no-split` | auto, map | `on` | advanced | Break a model its own verified pairs contradict. |
| `--fold-split` / `--no-fold-split` | auto, map | `on` | advanced | Cut a model that has written two places on top of each other, when the cut severs almost no co-visibility (D46) |
| `--fold-max-cut` | auto, map | `0.005` | advanced | Co-visibility that cut may sever, as a fraction of the model's total. Range 0 to 1. |
| `--fold-min-overlap` | auto, map | `0.5` | advanced | Images of a cut-off piece that must stand where an image outside it stands, or it is put back rather than called a duplicate (D67); 0 disables. Range 0 to 1. |
| `--joint-ba` / `--no-joint-ba` | auto, map | `on` | alias | Another spelling of `--bup-joint-intrinsics`. |
| `--seam-min-agreement` | auto, map | `0.6` | advanced | Verified pairs crossing a merge seam that must still hold in the merged model; 0 disables. Range 0 to 1. |
| `--seam-relative-bar` | auto, map | `0.6` | advanced | Judge a seam against what the model's own non-crossing pairs explain, times this; it only ever loosens --seam-min-pair-fraction (D68). 0 uses that flat. Range 0 to 10. |
| `--seam-min-pairs` | auto, map | `10` | advanced | Cross-seam pairs below which the seam test has nothing to judge on. Range 1 to 100000. |
| `--seam-rescue` | auto, map | `0.2` | advanced | Median cross-seam pair a refused merge must still explain to earn one refinement and a second verdict; 0 refuses outright. Range 0 to 1. |
| `--seam-max-rescues` | auto, map | `8` | advanced | Refinements the seam rescue may spend in one merge pass. Range 0 to 100000. |

### Merge

| Flag | Commands | Default | Tier | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--max-error` | merge | `8` | advanced | Alignment inlier threshold in pixels; looser than the mapper's, as the two models were optimized independently. Range 0.1 to 1000. |
| `--merge-max-error` | auto, map | `8` | advanced | Alignment inlier threshold in pixels for the merge step. Range 0.1 to 1000. |
| `--min-common` | merge | `3` | advanced | Shared images an alignment needs; two determine a Sim(3), three give it a vote. Range 2 to 1000000. |
| `--merge-min-common` | auto, map | `3` | advanced | Shared images an alignment needs in the merge step. Range 2 to 1000000. |
| `--merge-arbitrate` | auto, map, merge | `20` | advanced | Shared images whose poses agree, past which a disagreement about the shape of what two models share is arbitrated by the cross-seam test instead of refusing the merge; 0 always refuses. Range 0 to 1000000. |
| `--min-inlier-ratio` | merge | `0.3` | advanced | Fraction of the shared images an alignment must explain. Range 0 to 1. |
| `--filter-error` | merge | `4` | advanced | Post-merge observation filtering, in pixels. Range 0 to 1000. |
| `--min-tri-angle` | merge | `1.5` | advanced | Post-merge triangulation-angle filtering. Range 0 to 90. |
| `--ba` / `--no-ba` | merge | `on` | advanced | Bundle-adjust across the seams a merge created; the seam is the one part no BA has seen. |
| `--in-place` / `--no-in-place` | merge | `off` | advanced | Write the merged models back over the input directory. |

### Input

| Flag | Commands | Default | Tier | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--images` | map, merge | `none` | advanced | Image directory, used to put real filenames back into the model. |
| `--features` | map | `none` | advanced | Feature directory, if not given positionally. |
| `--resume` | map | `none` | advanced | Adopt the models in this directory instead of mapping from scratch (D44) |
| `--resume` / `--no-resume` | auto | `on` | basic | Pick up the features, pair list and verified pairs an interrupted run of the same settings left in the output folder. |
| `--reuse-features` | auto | `auto` | advanced | The features already in the output folder: auto reuses them while the settings that made them read the same, keep reuses them whatever made them, redo extracts them again. One of: `auto`, `keep`, `redo`. |
| `--reuse-matches` | auto | `auto` | advanced | The verified pairs already in matches.bin: auto reuses them while the settings and the features that made them are the same, keep reuses them over the same unchanged features whatever settings made them, redo matches again. One of: `auto`, `keep`, `redo`. |
| `--check` / `--no-check` | map | `off` | advanced | With --resume: report how far each model agrees with the two-view geometries it was built from, then exit without writing anything. |

### Runtime

| Flag | Commands | Default | Tier | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--threads` | auto, match, map | `0` | advanced | Host worker threads: two-view verification, and the mapper's per-point and per-image passes; 0 is every core, 1 is serial, and results do not depend on the count. Range 0 to 4096. |
| `--decode-threads` | auto, extract | `0` | advanced | Image decode threads; 0 is every core, 1 decodes inline. Range 0 to 4096. |
| `--decode-budget` | auto, extract | `0` | advanced | Memory the decode pool may hold in flight, in MB. Range 0 to 1048576. |
| `--device` | auto, extract, match, map, merge | `none` | advanced | Vulkan device: an index, part of a name, `auto`, or uuid:&lt;32 hex digits>; auto picks the first suitable one. |
| `--quiet` / `--no-quiet` | auto, extract, match, map, merge | `off` | advanced | Print only the result lines, not per-stage progress. |
